observations.behavior: Documentation update: clarifies that the semgrep rule checks URL arguments, not variable construction, and that review is the only safeguard.
observations.code_quote: The `github-api-calls-go-through-egress` semgrep rule reads the URL argument only, so a call that builds its URL into a variable first gets past it, and review is the only check on that shape.
